title: Modern Padded Horizontal Channel Headboard – Fabric Headboard UK
descriptionHtml:
Deep horizontal channels give the Modern Padded Horizontal Channel Headboard a plush, tactile finish that still reads as clean and modern. It is padded, built on a solid hardwood frame, and handmade to order in Dewsbury.

Key features

  • Deep horizontal channel stitching
  • Padded surface on a solid hardwood frame
  • Wall-mounted or fixed to a divan base
  • Made-to-measure options on request

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £181.99; Small Double (4FT) £207.99; Double (4FT6) £220.99; King (5FT) £259.99; Super King (6FT) £298.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Padded upholstery on a solid hardwood frame, handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. The product photos show a soft cream fabric; other fabrics and colours are available from our range and made-to-measure options are available on request. Free fabric swatches let you check the colour at home.

Fitting

This listing is for the headboard only. It can be wall-mounted or fixed to a divan base, so it works with a divan base you already own. Need help with fitting? Call 07417 439197 before you order.

Delivery, returns & warranty

We deliver free to addresses across Great Britain with our own delivery team, normally in 3-5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90. Returns are free within 14 days for unused, unassembled items in original packaging (we collect). Faulty items are replaced free or refunded in full. Every headboard has a 5-year warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

What is the difference between this and the Elite Horizontal headboard?

The channels here are deeper and softer. The Elite Horizontal Panel Headboard has wide, flatter horizontal panels.

Which fabrics are available?

Colours and fabrics can be chosen from our range; the product photos show cream. Free swatches are available.

When will it arrive?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.
